one_liner: Supabase provides a Postgres backend with REST, GraphQL, and SDKs for developers.
gating_notes: Free tier available for self-serve credential generation; API keys are project-specific.
oauth_details: OAuth is supported for user authentication via identity providers, but API access uses API keys.

auth_methods.quote: Every request to your Supabase project carries an API key. The key identifies what is calling your project: a web page, a mobile app, a server, or an Edge Function.

primary_auth.quote: An API key authenticates an application component to give it access to Supabase services. An application component might be a web page, a mobile app, or a server.

credential_access.quote: Start with a quickstart guide to connect your project in minutes.

api_type.quote: To convert SQL queries to `supabase-js` calls, use the [SQL to REST API translator](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/api/sql-to-rest).

api_breadth.quote: This reference documents every object and method available in Supabase's isomorphic JavaScript library, supabase-js.
